What We offer

Radio Advertising

AM/FM Radio Campaigns

Strategic ad placement on top-rated local and national radio stations to reach engaged commuters and loyal listeners.

Community Management

Targeted audio advertising on Spotify, Apple Music, and podcast platforms to reach digital-first audiences.

Audience Targeting

Data-driven station and daypart selection to connect your message with the right demographics at the right time.

Performance & Attribution

Comprehensive tracking, lift studies, and ROI reporting to measure real campaign impact and optimize spend.

Local Advertising

Power Your Message With Local Radio

Radio earns something rare: undivided attention during the drive, the workout, and the workday. It pairs broad reach with the emotional pull of the human voice to build trust no banner ad can match. From local stations to national networks and streaming audio, Kosick Communications places your message where listeners are already tuned in, then turns that attention into awareness, recall, and sales. With more than 40 years of media buying experience, we know which stations, shows, and dayparts deliver your audience, and we negotiate the rates to reach them efficiently.

  • Reach commuters during high-engagement drive times
  • Build brand familiarity through repeated listener exposure
  • Cost-effective reach compared to TV and digital video
  • Emotional connection through voice, music, and sound
Learn More

STRATEGIC MEDIA MIX

Expanding Your Media Mix Has Never Been More Important

Maximize your impact with expert media buying built to drive real results. Our team develops calculated, data-driven marketing plans spanning traditional and digital platforms, including TV, radio, outdoor, and streaming, so each channel reinforces the others and your budget works harder across the full mix. Audio rarely works in isolation, and the brands people remember are the ones they hear and see in more than one place. We coordinate every touchpoint into a single plan, keeping your message consistent from the morning commute to the evening scroll.

  • Multi-platform campaign strategies across audio channels
  • Cost-effective media allocation and rate negotiation
  • Audience-first targeting with station and daypart precision
  • Measurable ROI across radio, streaming, and podcast
Work with us

Vancouver Radio Advertising

Target the Right Creative to the Right Audiences

Great radio is the right message, on the right station, at the right moment. By understanding your audience and matching your message to the formats they trust, we make sure your brand gets noticed, remembered, and acted on. From station and daypart selection to script and production, we manage the details so every advertising dollar works as hard as it can. We then track performance against your goals and adjust the buy as results come in, shifting spend toward the placements proving they deliver.

  • Demographic and psychographic audience matching
  • Drive-time and daypart optimization
  • Frequency strategies for maximum brand recall
  • Real-time campaign adjustments and optimization
Connect With Us

Have Questions?

Frequently Asked Questions

Radio advertising costs depend on the market, station ratings, time slot, and campaign length. Local spots can start from a few hundred dollars per week, while drive-time slots on top-rated stations command premium rates. We negotiate the best rates through our station relationships and optimize your budget for maximum reach and frequency.

We analyze audience demographics, listening habits, station ratings (PPM/diary data), and geographic reach to match your target market. We also evaluate daypart performance, morning drive, afternoon drive, midday, and evening—to place your ads when your audience is most engaged.

Absolutely. Radio is one of the most effective channels for amplifying digital campaigns. Studies show that radio drives a significant lift in branded search and website traffic. We design integrated strategies that combine radio, streaming audio, and digital for maximum cross-channel impact.

Yes. Our creative team handles everything from scriptwriting and voice talent casting to full audio production. We craft compelling radio spots that capture attention, communicate your value proposition, and drive listener action, all aligned with your brand voice.

We use a combination of reach and frequency metrics, website traffic lift analysis, branded search volume correlation, call tracking, and promo code attribution. For streaming audio, we have access to detailed impression-level data and conversion tracking.

We recommend a minimum 4-week flight to build sufficient frequency and brand recall. Radio is a frequency medium—listeners need to hear your message multiple times before taking action. We tailor flight schedules to your goals, whether it’s a seasonal push or year-round brand presence.

Ready to Be Heard?

Let’s discuss how radio and streaming audio advertising can amplify your brand and drive real business results.
